decision: build Quill as a SwiftPM app plus a bundle script, no Xcode project
why: fewest files; swift 6.4 and Xcode 27 are installed; an Info.plist is all the mic permission needs

decision: Claude Code over ACP edits the file on disk itself and asks permission first; it never calls fs/write_text_file
why: ran a raw JSON-RPC client against claude-agent-acp 0.99.1 on a sample pitch
result: edit landed on disk in 5.4s, session/new 3.0s

decision: every agent path reads the file after each completed edit tool call and hands the text to propose()
why: the probe showed the disk is the real channel; one path is simpler than two

decision: Codex via codex-acp 0.16 is unusable with a ChatGPT login; defer Codex to a codex app-server adapter
why: the adapter's bundled core is older than the backend; it rejected gpt-6-luna and gpt-5.5

decision: user's ~/.codex/config.toml sets model_reasoning_effort=max, which codex-acp cannot parse; left the file alone
why: not my file to change; -c overrides work around it

decision: word-level diff on stdlib CollectionDifference plus a three-way merge so typing during a turn is never overwritten
why: every agent path ends in a full proposed text; one pure merge handles all of them

decision: no Markdown dependency; a per-line regex scanner drives live preview
why: ponytail: Foundation regex covers the prose subset and is fast per paragraph

decision: dissolve built from Core Animation tiles sampled from a snapshot, not Metal
why: native platform rung; a few hundred GPU-composited layers is enough

decision: Anthropic API agent uses claude-opus-5-5 at low effort with server-side refusal fallback
why: claude-api skill mandates Opus 5.5 unless the user names a model; low effort keeps latency down

decision: first end-to-end turn through the real UI: Cmd-K, typed request, Claude Code over ACP, three changes animated, saved to disk
why: drive the real surface, not a mock

decision: dust now plays over the old text in place before the new text replaces it
why: frames showed new text reflowing under the dust, reading as garbled overlap

decision: replaced TextKit 2 rendering attributes with a marks table applied during restyle
why: frames showed adds that never redrew and invalidation that wiped them; storage attributes always redraw
result: strike, dust, type-in all visible in order; undo exact

decision: on-device speech transcribed a say-generated request exactly in 0.16-0.26s
why: the live mic path needs a permission dialog only the user can click, so test the analyzer with a file

decision: Anthropic API agent not verified live: every key in envsync returns 401 from plain curl
why: the vault keys are revoked; app showed the right error and left the doc untouched

decision: Codex runs through codex app-server with sandbox workspace-write and approvalPolicy never; ACP and Codex share one RPC class
why: app-server uses the installed CLI and ChatGPT login; the sandbox confines writes to the vault structurally
